cancellation: Cancellation Policy All cancellations made over the phone must be canceled prior to 48hrs before your rental date in order to avoid a cancellation fee. If cancelled after 48hrs, you will receive a voucher for a future rental not a refund.
policies: If cancelled after 48hrs, you will receive a voucher for a future rental not a refund.
If weather inhibits your rental due to lighting, thunder, hail, or torrential down pouring, we do not offer refunds.
Please make sure to keep up with current weather reports if you are traveling from out of town!
Reservations made online forfeit the cancellation policy window and are non-refundable. We are looking forward to seeing you!
